measured_result.fixture: 10 deterministic multi-hop possibility queries + 400 distractor records

negative_checks: required CONFLICT node blocked candidate admissibility
same lineage_root support counted once rather than as independent replication
interpretation: This is measurable positive mechanism evidence for the possibility-conditioned preprocessor on this synthetic task class. It is not evidence that UnifiedDB is globally more accurate than all conventional databases/retrievers and not live-FRANK outcome evidence.
counterhypotheses: Synthetic expected labels and graph relations may align with the implemented scoring policy.
Dense/late-interaction or graph-RAG baselines may recover the same evidence with lower maintenance or latency cost.
Real/stale/noisy ClayGraph edges may erase the synthetic quality gain.
Always-on preprocessing may improve retrieval metrics but harm downstream answer quality through selection/compression bias.
next_gate: Held-out real Clay/FRANK snapshot benchmark with independent episode/seed units, null queries, stale/corrupt graph variants, edge lesions, FTS5/BM25 + dense + graph-RAG baselines, p50/p95/p99 latency, rebuild/memory/token cost, counterevidence recall and downstream task outcome.
ancestry_policy: Benchmark tool, packet, V10 runtime and preprocessor are one coordinated development lineage. The two synthetic scoring iterations are not independent scientific replications.
